notes.value: Chery Tiggo 7 Premium PHEV (FWD), locally assembled by Chery Master Pakistan. Per Chery's Pakistan brochure: fifth-generation Super Hybrid with a 1.5 TGDI engine (1,499 cc), a dedicated hybrid transmission (DHT) and one motor, 255 kW (342 hp) and 525 Nm combined, front-wheel drive, 0–100 km/h in 8.4 s, 18.3 kWh battery, 90+ km on electricity (NEDC per PakNEV) and 1,200+ km combined from the 60 L tank. DC charging 40 kW; a 7 kW wallbox and a portable charger are supplied; vehicle-to-load 3.3 kW. 4,553 × 1,862 × 1,696 mm on a 2,670 mm wheelbase, 175 mm ground clearance, 18-inch wheels on 225/60 R18, 565 L boot (1,386 L with the rear seats folded), 1,785 kg, 5 seats. Equipment includes 8 airbags, a 540° camera, Level 2 ADAS, a 24.6-inch dual curved display, 8 Sony speakers, heated and ventilated front seats and a panoramic sunroof. PKR 9,499,000 from 17 September 2026 for limited stock (July list price PKR 10,949,000). Warranty 6 years / 150,000 km, battery 8 years / 160,000 km. Sources: Chery Pakistan brochure, PakNEV.

notes.value: Chery Tiggo 8 Premium PHEV, a seven-seat SUV locally assembled by Chery Master Pakistan. 1.5 TGDI engine (1,499 cc) with Chery's Super Hybrid system and all-wheel drive; Pakistan figures 496 hp and 735 Nm, 0–100 km/h in 6.8 s, 180 km/h. Per Chery's training deck: 90 km on electricity (WLTC) and 1,200+ km combined; AC 6.6 kW (about 3 hours) and DC 40 kW with 30–80% in 20 minutes; vehicle-to-load 3.3 kW; 10 airbags, a 15.6-inch 2.5K screen with W-HUD, 12 Sony speakers and a 540° camera. 4,725 × 1,860 × 1,705 mm on a 2,710 mm wheelbase, 200 mm ground clearance, 494 L boot (PakNEV), 2,063 kg, 7 seats. Battery reported as 19.27 kWh (PakNEV says 18.3 kWh). PKR 10,999,000 from 17 September 2026 for limited stock (July list price PKR 12,999,000). Warranty 6 years / 150,000 km, battery 8 years / 160,000 km. Sources: Chery training deck, PakNEV, PakWheels.

notes.value: Chery Tiggo 9 Premium PHEV (AWD), the seven-seat flagship, locally assembled by Chery Master Pakistan. Per Chery's Pakistan brochure: 1.5 TGDI engine (1,499 cc) with three motors and a 3-speed DHT, 455 kW (610 hp) and 920 Nm combined, all-wheel drive, 0–100 km/h in 5.4 s, 34.46 kWh battery, 170 km electric range and up to 1,400 km combined (both NEDC) from the 70 L tank, six drive modes including Snow, Sand and Off-road. DC charging up to 71 kW through CCS2, AC 7 kW (PakNEV), vehicle-to-load 6.6 kW. 4,810 × 1,925 × 1,741 mm on a 2,800 mm wheelbase, 147/183 mm ground clearance laden/unladen, 20-inch wheels on Cooper 245/50 R20, 448 L boot (PakNEV), 2,308 kg, 7 seats. Equipment includes front, side, curtain, second-row side, knee and far-side airbags; a 540° camera and automatic parking; full ADAS; a 15.6-inch screen, 10.25-inch cluster and W-HUD; 14 Sony speakers; heated, ventilated and massaging front seats; heated and ventilated second-row seats; and a panoramic roof with full electric shade. PKR 14,299,000 for limited stock (July list price PKR 15,749,000; launch price PKR 13,694,000). Warranty 6 years / 150,000 km, battery 8 years / 160,000 km. Sources: Chery Pakistan brochure, PakNEV, Profit.
